_comment: Portable, committed TEMPLATE — disabled by default and safe for source control.
It contains no machine-specific paths, credentials, or managed installation state.
While disabled, no executable is resolved and no subprocess is started.
Phase F never writes this file: a provisioned server's generated configuration
automatically while that server is enabled.
To point at a hand-installed server without editing this file, set
MCP_CONFIG_PATH to your own JSON file (see docs/PHASE_E.md).
